def factor_adaptive_pressure_ewm_vol_gate(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret = df_copy['open'] / df_copy['close'].shift(1) - 1.0
    intraday_ret = df_copy['close'] / df_copy['open'] - 1.0
    pressure = intraday_ret - overnight_ret
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy['volume'], window=20)
    pressure_short = pressure.ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean()
    pressure_long = pressure.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean()
    factor = np.where(is_high_vol > 0, pressure_short, pressure_long)
    df_copy['factor_adaptive_pressure_ewm_vol_gate'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_adaptive_pressure_ewm_vol_gate']
description: Intraday minus overnight return measures directional conviction. This mutation replaces the original volatility-based regime gate with a volume-based regime gate from alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime. High-volume periods may indicate greater market participation and information flow, so a shorter smoothing span (3) captures rapid shifts in conviction; during low-volume periods, a longer span (5) provides stability. This preserves the core pressure mechanism while using a more market-wide volume context to adapt smoothing.
